notes: CopyDB15: 4x-unrolled indexed table-copy with a pusha/popa (60/61) save band - bare 32-bit pusha/popa is asm-only, so the whole body is naked asm (SetFlatColor _emit recipe for 60/61). Params (cdecl, 4 args, [ebp+8/0xc/0x10/0x14]): table base edi, dst edx, byte-index array esi, stride ecx; per element bl=*p++, row=tab+(bl<<3) (shl bx,3 keeps 16-bit index math), copies row[0],row[1] to dst[col]/dst[col+stride] with FA's own un-scheduled add/sub edx,4/ecx dance. Trailing census pad 2e 8b c0 auto-accepted.
